caveat: Both periods were inspected in earlier conversations. This is exploratory chronological separation, not fresh independent validation. Many equivalent policies and multiple comparisons.
training_selection: At least3 training tickets; maximize Laplace-smoothed hit rate (wins+1)/(n+2), ties more training tickets then lower predefined policy id. Select separately per odds band, never by evaluation outcome.
hindsight_selection: Separate diagnostic only: best full-period hit rate among rules with >=8 tickets; not a prospective result.
builder: Greedy: best permitted market per fixture by ranking, then sorted prefixes up to12; highest estimated joint probability across admissible prefixes and single bookmakers. Not exhaustive combination enumeration.
real_prices: Win,DC,totals,BTTS observed pre-decision. Four combos synthetic. All known at08:00 Lisbon first day; quotes<6h. One selection per fixture. Teams may repeat on different fixtures after relaxing former limits.
